title: This Program Contains Dialogue
description: EyeWash pre-program warning. Continuity Voice sings the disclosure; S&P will not stamp until someone talks.
stylePrompt: Institutional torch / legal-bumper hymn at 84 BPM. Narrow-bandwidth Continuity Voice — warm, sincere, half-step flat on the word “dialogue.” Small chapel organ that sounds like a legal department. Color-bar sine as a pedal tone. Tape hiss. No drums until a single rubber stamp on the last line. No belting. No vibrato. **Structural flaw:** he recites the warning as a song, which is not dialogue; after every chorus he adds one spoken aside to satisfy Standards & Practices; S&P is never satisfied; the card still reads CONTAINS DIALOGUE. The listed contents may grow; the bar count does not. Mood: EyeWash pre-program warning, not a sign-off. Runtime ~1:25–1:45. Use Continuity Voice; the S&P Skeleton may stamp once, dry, off-mic. Do not use Rubella.
lyrics:
[Intro — color bars / organ]
The following program contains dialogue.
Viewer discretion is a zoning matter.

[Verse 1]
There will be sentences
There will be answers that arrive late
There will be a woman who is correct about a gate
This has been disclosed.

[Pre-Chorus]
If you wanted music
That is a different block
This block contains dialogue

[Chorus]
This program contains dialogue
We are not liable for what you heard
We are liable for the aspect ratio
Please hold your comments

[Spoken aside 1]
(That was singing.)
(Please continue.)

[Verse 2]
There will be indoor weather
There may be a dog
There will be one honest height
Nobody looks up. That is also disclosed.

[Pre-Chorus]
If you wanted silence
We have a rinse for that
This block contains dialogue

[Chorus 2]
This program contains dialogue
The tower predates the town
That is a zoning matter, not a mystery
Please hold your comments

[Spoken aside 2]
(Still singing.)
(The stamp is waiting.)

[Bridge]
Everyone gets fifteen minutes
That is not fame
That is the rinse duration
The following program is longer than that
We have disclosed the length
We have not disclosed the words

[Final]
This program contains dialogue
(stamp: PROBABLY FINE)
This program contains dialogue
(off-mic, dry)
Is this on.

[Spoken tag]
It is now.
We return you to your regularly scheduled difficulty.
notes:
## What the song is
The **pre-program warning** for the wordy episode. EyeWash is required to tell the affected that dialogue is coming. Continuity Voice does it as a hymn because that is how the station talks. Standards & Practices (the unionized skeleton, day job) is not satisfied: singing is not dialogue. He waits. Someone off-mic finally says “Is this on.” The stamp comes down. The card never changes.

The joke is the disclosure, not the wordiness. Nobody says “this is the talky one.”
